description.en: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Adversaries try to break a change or design, and only findings proven by a run survive.
description.zh: 用于「interrogate」「对抗式审查」「多模型审查」「挑战一下这个」「压力测试这段代码」「找盲点」或「把它拆个稀烂」。对手们想办法弄坏一个改动或设计，只有被一次运行证明了的发现才能留下。

blocks.en: Adversaries try to break a change or a design. A finding survives only when a run proves it. Report the findings. Do not apply fixes.
blocks.zh: 对手们想办法弄坏一个改动或一个设计。一个发现，只有被一次运行证明了，才能留下。报告这些发现。不要动手修。

blocks.en: The scope is what the user names. Otherwise it is the branch diff from its merge base with the base branch, through the working tree. State the intent with the **in-your-own-words** skill, from the user's message, the commits, and the PR description. Ask the user when the intent is unclear.
blocks.zh: 范围是用户点名的东西。否则，就是当前分支从它和基础分支的合并基点开始、一直到工作区的 diff。用 **in-your-own-words** 技能，根据用户的消息、提交和 PR 说明，复述出意图（这个改动想做到什么）。意图不清楚时，问用户。

blocks.en: Run Phase A steps 3 and 4 and Phase B of the **arena** skill, with four changes. Read the `interrogate reviewers` line in place of `arena runners`. Copy the scope's uncommitted changes into each worktree. Spawn each adversary as a general-purpose subagent (`generalPurpose` in Cursor). In place of the arena task and rationale, give each adversary the scope, the intent, and this brief:
blocks.zh: 运行 **arena** 技能 Phase A 的第 3、4 步和 Phase B，但做四处改动。读 `interrogate reviewers` 这一行，代替 `arena runners`。把范围里还没提交的改动复制到每个 worktree。把每个对手都派成一个通用帮手 AI（Cursor 里是 `generalPurpose`）。不给 arena 的任务和理由，改为给每个对手：范围、意图，以及这份简报：

blocks.en: > Break this change. Prove each finding with a run against the real code, such as a failing test, a repro script, or command output that shows the wrong behavior. For a design or plan, run a prototype or probe the current tree. Keep repros in your own worktree. Report each finding with a title, the exact command, the output it printed, and the output the intent requires. Leave out anything you did not run. That covers style, naming, structure, and risks that need a future change to matter. No findings is a valid result.
blocks.zh: > 弄坏这个改动。每个发现都要用一次针对真实代码的运行来证明，比如一个失败的测试、一个复现脚本，或者显示出错误行为的命令输出。如果是设计或计划，就跑一个原型，或者去探查当前的代码树。复现都放在你自己的 worktree 里。每个发现都要报告：标题、确切的命令、它打印出的输出，以及意图要求的输出。没跑过的，都不要写。这包括风格、命名、结构，以及要等将来某次改动才会成问题的风险。没有发现，也是一个有效的结果。

blocks.en: Verify each finding per arena Phase F by rerunning its command. Keep a finding when the output shows the failure and the failure breaks the intent. Drop the rest. Merge findings that share a root cause.
blocks.zh: 按 arena 的 Phase F，重跑每个发现的命令来核实它。输出显示了失败，而且这个失败违背了意图，就留下这个发现。其余的丢掉。真正原因相同的发现，合并成一个。

blocks.en: Skip arena Phases C, D, and E. Adversaries find different failures, so the verdict keeps every verified finding, not one adversary's list.
blocks.zh: 跳过 arena 的 Phase C、D 和 E。不同的对手会找到不同的失败，所以结论保留每一个核实过的发现，而不是只用某一个对手的清单。

blocks.en:
- **Intent**: the restatement.
- **Findings**: for each verified finding, the command, its output, how it breaks the intent, and the adversaries that found it. Say "no verified findings" when none survive.
- **Dropped**: for each adversary, the count of dropped findings and why.
blocks.zh:
- **意图**：复述出来的意图。
- **发现**：每个核实过的发现，写出命令、它的输出、它怎样违背了意图，以及是哪些对手找到的。一个都没留下时，写「没有核实过的发现」。
- **丢掉的**：每个对手丢掉了几个发现，以及为什么。

lessons.quote: Adversaries try to break a change or a design.
lessons.quoteZh: 对手们想办法弄坏一个改动或一个设计。

zh.title: 给 AI 一个对立的身份
zh.does: 派出去的帮手 AI 不是来帮代码说好话的，而是专门想办法把它弄坏。
zh.why: 「对手」「弄坏」把任务从「检查一下」变成「攻破它」，AI 会更卖力地找问题。
zh.try: 让 AI 审方案时说：「你是最挑剔的竞争对手，想办法证明这份方案行不通。」

en.title: Cast the AI as an opponent
en.does: The helpers aren't there to vouch for the code. Their job is to break it.
en.why: "Adversary" and "break" turn "take a look" into "defeat it", so the AI hunts harder.
en.try: When the AI reviews a plan, say: "You're the toughest competitor. Prove this plan won't work."

lessons.quote: Report each finding with a title, the exact command, the output it printed, and the output the intent requires.
lessons.quoteZh: 每个发现都要报告：标题、确切的命令、它打印出的输出，以及意图要求的输出。

zh.title: 要实际和应该并排写
zh.does: 每个问题都附上命令、实际输出和本该有的输出，你自己就能重跑核对。
zh.why: 把「实际是什么」和「应该是什么」并排写出来，问题在哪一目了然，也没法空口说。
zh.try: 让 AI 报 bug 时写：「每条都写清：怎么操作、看到了什么、本来应该看到什么。」

en.title: Put actual next to expected
en.does: Each problem comes with the command, what it printed, and what it should print, so you can rerun it.
en.why: Writing "what happened" next to "what should happen" shows the gap at once and leaves no room for hand-waving.
en.try: When the AI reports bugs, write: "For each: what you did, what you saw, what you expected to see."

lessons.quote: Leave out anything you did not run. That covers style, naming, structure, and risks that need a future change to matter.
lessons.quoteZh: 没跑过的，都不要写。这包括风格、命名、结构，以及要等将来某次改动才会成问题的风险。

zh.title: 点明规则管到哪些
zh.does: 它不会拿命名、风格或「以后可能出事」来凑数，报上来的都是跑出来的问题。
zh.why: 光说「没跑过的不写」，AI 会觉得风格意见不算；把最容易混进来的几类点名，就没有空子可钻。
zh.try: 让 AI 挑错时写：「只报会让顾客付不了钱的问题。配色、措辞、以后可能出的问题都不算。」

en.title: Name what the rule covers
en.does: It won't pad the list with naming, style, or "might break later". Every finding was actually run.
en.why: "Leave out what you didn't run" leaves gaps. Naming the kinds most likely to sneak in closes them.
en.try: When the AI hunts for problems, write: "Only report what stops a customer paying. Colors, wording, and future risks don't count."

lessons.quote: No findings is a valid result.
lessons.quoteZh: 没有发现，也是一个有效的结果。

zh.title: 明说「没有」也算交差
zh.does: 代码没问题时，它就说没问题，不会硬凑几个问题显得卖力。
zh.why: AI 默认觉得「找问题」就得找出点什么，明说空结果也有效，就卸掉了这份压力。
zh.try: 让 AI 检查时加一句：「如果没找到错别字，直接回复『没找到』就行。」

en.title: Say "nothing" is a fine answer
en.does: When the code is fine, it says so instead of inventing problems to look busy.
en.why: An AI asked to find problems feels it must find some. Saying an empty result counts removes that pressure.
en.try: When the AI checks your work, add: "If you find no typos, just reply 'none found'."

compare.without: 列一堆风格、命名上的意见凑数
compare.with: 每个问题都附上命令、实际输出和该有的输出

compare.without: 对手 AI 说有问题就照单全收
compare.with: 把每个发现的命令重跑一遍，跑不出失败就删掉

compare.without: 找到问题顺手就改了代码
compare.with: 只交报告，修不修由你决定

zh.intro: 说明几个对手 AI 专门想办法弄坏改动，只有跑出来的问题才算数，它只报告，不动手修。
sections: 没指定范围就审整个分支的改动，用 `in-your-own-words` 复述这次想做什么，不清楚就问你。
借用 `arena` 的派发步骤，给每个对手一个 worktree 和同一份「弄坏它」的任务说明。
重跑每个发现的命令，输出确实失败且违背目标的才留下，同一原因的合并成一条。
报告分三块：复述的目标，每个留下的发现和谁发现的，每个对手被删了几条、为什么。

compare.without: Pads the list with style and naming opinions.
compare.with: Gives each finding with the command, its actual output, and the expected output.

compare.without: Accepts whatever a reviewer claims is broken.
compare.with: Reruns every finding's command and drops any that don't show the failure.

compare.without: Fixes the code as soon as it spots a problem.
compare.with: Hands back a report only. You decide what to fix.

en.intro: It says adversaries try to break the change, only findings proven by a run count, and it reports without fixing.
sections: Defaults to the whole branch diff, restates the intent with `in-your-own-words`, and asks you when the intent is unclear.
Reuses `arena`'s spawning steps, giving each adversary its own worktree and the same "break this change" brief.
Reruns each finding's command, keeps it only if it fails and breaks the intent, and merges shared root causes.
Reports three parts: the restated intent, each verified finding with who found it, and each adversary's dropped count and reasons.
